official.description: Reach Oxford scholarships (formerly Oxford Student Scholarships) are offered to students from low-income countries who, for political or financial reasons, or because suitable educational facilities do not exist, cannot study for a degree in their own countries. The University states the scheme is only suitable for candidates who have received an offer and who are of the highest academic ability.

applicant_utility.summary: Reach Oxford covers course fees, a living-costs grant and one return air fare per year for three or four years, but only around two to three awards exist annually, so treat it as a small lottery layered on top of a successful UCAS application. Oxford cannot consider you without an offer, so admissions come first and the scholarship step follows in January. selection weighs highest academic ability together with financial need, social commitment and demonstrable inability to study a degree at home, so every criterion needs documentary evidence rather than assertion.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Highest-ability students from DAC-listed low-income countries who hold or expect an Oxford offer outside medicine and genuinely cannot complete a degree at home.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure an Oxford offer through UCAS by the October deadline before anything else
Assemble documentary evidence of financial need and of why a degree in your home country is impossible for you
List concrete social-commitment activities with dates, roles and hours
Monitor the Reach Oxford page through December 2026 for the 2027 entry instructions published in January 2027
Diarise 12 noon UK time on 26 January 2027, which sits mid-summer for many southern-hemisphere applicants
common_rejection_risks: Assuming the scholarship is assessed automatically with the UCAS application instead of a separate post-offer step
Applying to medicine, which the scheme excludes
Applying in the wrong cycle after a deferred offer, since each candidate can only be considered once
Being placed at a college that does not participate in the scheme in a given year and not engaging with the transfer arrangement
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Not stated as covered: visa and immigration costs, the immigration health surcharge, living costs outside term, and any travel beyond the one annual return air fare.
document_audit: Financial-need evidence must reflect household circumstances with supporting papers, not a self-declaration alone
Evidence of inability to study for a degree in your country is a separate test from general financial need and fails when conflated with it
Use only the document list published in the January 2027 instructions; earlier years' lists can mislead
alerts: You can only be considered for an Oxford undergraduate scholarship once, so never spend the single attempt on an incomplete file
If your college does not participate in the scheme you will be transferred when awarded, so choose colleges with that possibility in mind
With only 2-3 awards a year, most eligible applicants go unfunded, so maintain a parallel funding plan
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: UCAS application, Oxford offer, then the separate Reach Oxford application via the official January 2027 instructions, with selection in April 2027.
